component.name: Kobra Slicer
component.summary: Direct upload-and-print for the Anycubic Kobra 3 Max, on an OrcaSlicer base

description.p: Kobra Slicer is an independent, unofficial fork of OrcaSlicer, built to add real, working upload-and-print support for the Anycubic Kobra 3 Max over the printer's own local LAN protocol, on completely stock firmware -- no Rinkhals or jailbreak required.

Everything OrcaSlicer already does -- ultra-fast slicing, intelligent support generation, advanced calibration tools -- stays intact. This fork adds a real, dedicated Anycubic print host and Kobra 3 Max profiles on top of it, built from genuine captured traffic rather than guesswork, including ACE Pro multi-colour tray selection.
Reads the printer's own real, self-reported model for upload telemetry instead of a hardcoded Kobra 3 Max string -- a step toward testing against other printers in the Kobra range.
First public release: real upload-and-print for the Anycubic Kobra 3 Max, confirmed end-to-end against real hardware, with ACE Pro multi-colour tool-changing and a Windows installer.
